scope: Exhaustive requirement extraction for guide sections6/7 and AppendicesA–C; not an inventory of all Prism features or other guide chapters.

read_complete.included: All prose, tables, code blocks, examples, caveats and source labels in assigned sections; document scripts read as evidence only and not executed.

audit_mode: Read-only application audit; only plan/evidence files written.

statuses.partial: A bounded subset exists; material requirements remain.
statuses.recovered_only: Source artifacts or format observations exist outside app; no functional implementation.
statuses.unresolved: Behavior specification itself needs reference evidence.

reference_blockers.R1: No live licensed macOS Prism reference is available here; app execution, reopen/save, GUI, and image behavior require a reference host.
reference_blockers.R2: Guide Appendix A references scratch .prism snapshots, DRG pcff.py/prismedit.py, original .pzc examples/logs and before/after files not present in the supplied guide extraction; recover them if available or generate isolated reference fixtures.
reference_blockers.R3: Guide is Prism 10.3.1 macOS, installer is Prism 11.1.0 macOS; version-specific claims require cross-version checks rather than blanket transfer.
reference_blockers.R4: Guide explicitly leaves this field/behavior undecoded or unverified; controlled differential artifacts/native tracing needed.
reference_blockers.R5: Browser cannot silently reproduce native filesystem, Launch Services, Automator, AppleScript, SQL drivers, printing or Office integration; specify browser file/capability adapters and platform compatibility boundaries.
reference_blockers.R6: Guide claim is documentation/bundle-only or failed in one lab run; not a verified portable behavior contract.
